alt: White gambrel shed with dark green trim and double doors under a new charcoal shingle roof, chain-link fence and woods behind

Fingertip pointing to torn, bunched EPDM membrane at a corner drain fitting on a flat roof edge, where the sheet should lap flat and sealed

Drone view of the crew stripping two layers of shingles down to plank decking on a two-story hip roof
Overhead drone view of a gray shingle roof with seven new low-profile vents and turbines installed, large fenced backyard below
Extension ladder reaching a third-story gable while a technician re-secures a piece of vinyl siding at the top
Three extension ladders set against the tall gable while a crew member installs new vinyl siding over fresh house wrap
Drone view at eave height of the brick ranch before work, its old dark three-tab roof weathered and streaked
Wind-stripped low-slope roof section with the mineral-surfaced roll roofing peeled back in a large ragged sheet
